items.title: Isaiah Likely: Solid despite Dart injury
items.description:
Likely secured five of 10 targets for 33 yards in the Giants' 28-6 loss to the Rams on Monday night.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jameis Winston: Forgettable effort in emergency duty
items.description: Winston replaced Jaxson Dart (knee) with 9:51 remaining in the first quarter of Monday night's 28-6 loss to the Rams and completed 11 of 27 passes for 111 yards with no touchdowns and one interception while rushing twice for one yard.

items.title: Matthew Stafford: Vintage effort sans Nacua in win
items.description:
Stafford completed 22 of 31 passes for 327 yards with four touchdowns and one interception and rushed four times for minus-1 yard in the Rams' 28-6 win over the Giants on Monday night.

items.title: Blake Corum: Even timeshare with Williams
items.description:
Corum rushed 12 times for 79 yards and brought in his only target for 13 yards in the Rams' 28-6 win over the Giants on Monday night. He also fumbled once but recovered.
